text:
REJECT
The patch won't build: the new `ChangeFilterSite` helper takes parameters typed `TestInvocation` and `CiChangeFilter`, but `ChangeFilters` iterates `List<Invocation>` and no `TestInvocation` or `CiChangeFilter` type exists anywhere in `engine/src`, so the call `ChangeFilterSite(filter, run, ...)` fails to compile (the logic itself is otherwise a faithful extraction).
